✦ 5-Stage Speechwriting Roadmap

STAGE 1

Outline & Ideas

Opening hook, main Torah thought, and personal takeaway.

STAGE 2

Drafting Speech

Writing the full paragraphs, stories, and thank-yous.

STAGE 3

Editing & Polish

Refining word choice, sentence flow, and speech length.

STAGE 4

Delivery & Pacing

Practicing speaking speed (~125 words/min) and eye contact.

STAGE 5

Mastered & Ready

Full confidence, final printed copies, and rehearsal complete.
